title: 355/113 approximates pi to six decimal places
body: Zu Chongzhi found in the 5th century that 355/113 matches pi to six decimal digits, a precision Europe would not beat for roughly a thousand years. Continued fractions explain the luck: 355/113 is a convergent, a best possible rational approximation for its size. Pi itself was proved irrational only in 1761, by Lambert.
source_hint: Zu Chongzhi (c. 480 CE); Lambert irrationality proof, 1761
